title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extraterrestrial event.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E02 — Trust Fall
Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart investigate a deadly shooting to prove an alien force was involved.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E03 — OutKast
John's parents train him to become the perfect candidate for the next Green Lantern. However, as John trains under Hal, he is disillusioned by Hal's teachings.

title: The Revenant
description: In 1823, fur trapper Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) treks through the snowy wilderness to track down John Fitzgerald (Tom Hardy), a member of his hunting team who killed his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and left him for dead.

title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
description: After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.

title: Mortal Kombat II
description: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

title: Stoker
description: After the tragic death of a girl's father, an eccentric uncle comes to live with the teen (Mia Wasikowska) and her unstable mother (Nicole Kidman). Though she suspects the man has ulterior motives, she becomes increasingly infatuated with him.

title: Amy
description: Archival footage and personal testimonials present an intimate portrait of the life and career of British singer/songwriter Amy Winehouse.

title: What Happened on September 11
description: Personal stories, classroom scenes and interviews with educators, and archival news footage and photos are used to help a younger generation better understand the events of Sept. 11 and their continued effect on the world.

title: Talk to Me
description: Karo is freshly separated and is struggling with the non-existing relationship with her father; when her mother Michaela wants to go on vacation with her to Rügen, Karo suspects there is again some failed love affair behind it.

title: Monsters of God
description:
S01 E05 — Head of the Snake
Malaysian kingpin Anson Wong emerges as a shadowy force at the center of the global reptile trade; a U.S. agent goes under cover to penetrate Wong's inner circle.

title: Conan O'Brien Must Go
description:
S03 E03 — Morocco
Conan forces his follower Yassir to watch the movie synonymous with his hometown, "Casablanca," and promises to get Sona, his podcast co-host, her beloved Moroccan argan oil.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E01
Having received their rings, the Super Bowl champion Seahawks head to training camp, where dreams of a repeat begin with the sound of pads popping.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E02
Competition helps to up the intensity of training camp, plus, QB Sam Darnold on his spin rate, DT Leonard Williams talks gardening, and more.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E03
HBO Sports and NFL Films join forces for an all-access look at the reigning Super Bowl Champion Seattle Seahawks in training camp.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E04
All-access look at the champion Seahawks' camp, capturing practices, locker room moments and NFL pressure.

title: Hard Knocks: Training Camp With the Seattle Seahawks
description:
S21 E05
Following head coach Mike Macdonald, quarterback Sam Darnold and the rest of the Super Bowl-winning Seattle Seahawks in training camp in Renton, Wash.

title: Taken 2
description: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
description: A couple is shocked when their missing daughter is returned to them after disappearing eight years earlier. However, what should be a joyful family reunion soon turns into a living nightmare as she starts to transform into something truly horrifying.

title: The Drama
description: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."

title: Blockers
description: Lisa, Hunter and Mitchell learn that their teenage daughters plan to lose their virginity on prom night. The worried parents soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.

title: Normal
description: The new sheriff of a small town in Minnesota uncovers a dark secret while investigating a botched bank robbery.

title: Sicario
description: Recruited by Matt Graver, FBI agent Kate Macer joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the U.S.-Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.

title: Albert Brooks: Defending My Life
description: From stand-up routines to acting, writing and directing, Albert Brooks becomes a major force in American comedy. Includes testimonials from Larry David, Chris Rock, Sarah Silverman, Jonah Hill, Judd Apatow, Steven Spielberg, James L. Brooks and more.

title: Ready Player One
description: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world.

title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
description: A washed-up actor (Michael Keaton), whose previous claim to fame was his portrayal of a popular superhero, attempts to recapture his past glory by mounting a Broadway play.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. Everyone's a suspect when Detective Hercule Poirot arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again.

title: The Long Walk
description: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

description: Republican Congressmen Matt Gaetz (R-Fla.), Thomas Massie (R-Ky.), and Ken Buck (R-Colo.) are tracked over the course of a pivotal year in politics, demonstrating the grip of a system that rewards fundraising above all else.
